details.note: New red placards were added, but at window range each reads as a single saturated pink-red speck (#c5666e in w26K at (565,227), #a9737f in w19A). It looks like a sticker or light, not a small ringed stencil. The movable-surface tint (uv[0] > 0.8) does not show: in w19A both spoiler and fixed skin sample #8a96a9/#8b96a9. Seams and fastener rows are unchanged, the gear stripe is fine, and the LE dot fringe is gone.

The breaks are now a shade under the paint, with no white pinstripes, which matches KN46/_7250. In w19A the 0.014 m chordwise spoiler breaks break up into dotted dashes (z19A). The spoiler-TE/flap gap stays the strong line, which is the correct hierarchy.

The flank grade is fixed: w26K samples lit upper flank #a9aeb4 against lower flank/keel #818384-#55575c, close to _7250. The profile has regressed again. The linear tail reaches a 0.28 depth at x1, and then a 0.40 m semi-ellipsoid of the same depth is added, so the keel line rises steeply and then runs flat into a round bulb. Every canoe in w26K and w19A reads as a sock or boot with a notch under a knob-shaped tip. In _7250, _7282 and KN41 the keel runs straight up to a slender wedge tip, about 10-15 % of the max depth, with only a small rounding. KN46's 'rounded end' is the round cross-section seen end-on, not a bulb in profile.

issues.problem: The linear tail taper to 0.3/0.28 at x1 is followed by a 0.40 m semi-ellipsoid of the same size. In profile the keel climbs steeply and then flattens into a round knob, so every canoe reads as a sock or boot with a notch. The real flaps-up canoe is a slender wedge: a straight keel rising to a small, slightly rounded tip about 10-15 % of the max depth, with a flat top continuing the wing lower surface.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/ratB7/z26K.png (notch under the end bulb on all three canoes) and z19A.png (hooked ends) against ref7250_canoe.png and _7282 (canoes at (650-750, 800-900) and (700-910, 700-760): straight keel to a narrow tip).
issues.fix: In the canoe loop: `RE = 0.40` -> `RE = 0.10`. In the main loop, replace `lerp(1, 0.3, tail(xn))` / `lerp(1, 0.28, tail(xn))` with `lerp(1, 0.16, Math.pow(tail(xn), 0.9))` for width and `lerp(1, 0.12, tail(xn))` for depth, so the keel is straight. Replace the cap loop with `for (const u of [0.5, 0.85]) { const e = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u); secs.push(sec(x1 + u * RE, Math.max(0.03, 0.16 * e), Math.max(0.03, 0.12 * e))); }`. Optionally pin the section top so it does not drop at the tip: in `sec` use `z: -(topAt(xn) - d / 2)` as now, but change topAt's aft slope `(xn - te(cs)) * 0.03` -> `* 0.0` so the top line stays flat. Keep the w6 flank shadeVerts. Target in w26K: tip depth <= 1/6 of the TE depth, with no inflection on the keel line.

issues.detail: placards read as saturated red specks
issues.problem: The 0.2 x 0.1 m solid #9a2a2a quads render as bright pink-red dashes (#c5666e) that draw the eye more than the registration. The real marks are small red-outlined stencils, barely visible at this range (KN46 shows a yellow dot, _7250 small ringed marks).
issues.evidence: w26K (565,227) #c5666e; w17K and w19A red dashes (/tmp/claude-0/ratB7/z26K.png, z19A.png).
issues.fix: In the placard loop: colour `{ c: '#9a2a2a', r: 0.8 }` -> `{ c: '#6e4446', r: 0.9, m: 0 }`, width 0.1 -> 0.06, length s +/- 0.1 -> s +/- 0.07. Or draw each as an outline: 4 wingLine segments 0.02 wide around a 0.18 x 0.12 rectangle, so it reads as a faint ringed mark.

issues.problem: The [0.93, 0.94, 0.97] tint only applies at uv[0] > 0.8. The spoilers start at about 0.7 chord, so in w19A the spoilers and the fixed skin are identical (#8a96a9 / #8b96a9).
issues.evidence: w19A samples (560,250) #8a96a9 vs (600,260) #8b96a9 across the hinge line.
issues.fix: In paintVerts, test the actual spoiler and flap boxes instead of uv[0] > 0.8. Pass the chord position x: if `x > spF(s) && s > 11.8 && s < 23.3`, or for the inboard pair `x > 37.82 && s > 4.5 && s < 8.6`, or `x > te(s) - 1.15` on the flaperon/flaps, use mv `[0.92, 0.93, 0.97]`. This needs spF/te defined before paintVerts (move those two consts above it).

issues.problem: The position is now right, but the mark is a ring with block 'GE'. The real mark is the script swirl monogram with a small 'GE' wordmark aft of it (knav 7A _9).
issues.fix: In the monogram block, replace the 3 polylines with 3 curled swashes, each an arc from the ring edge spiralling inward, e.g. for k in 0..2: `Array.from({length: 9}, (_, j) => { const a = k * 2.094 + j * 0.35, r = 0.2 - j * 0.017; return [Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r]; })`, tube 0.022. Add a wordmark: two small block glyphs 0.10 m tall at u = -0.42 (aft), tube 0.012.
